name: W Goa
positioning: A W resort on Vagator Beach in North Goa, with a cliffside sunset bar over the Arabian Sea, AWAY Spa and art by Goan artist Subodh Kerkar
best_for: Couples and friends who want a lively beach resort with sunset cocktails and music
Travelers who want to explore North Goa, from Chapora Fort to the coast

facts.text: Accommodation includes rooms, suites, villas and chalets, with Portuguese-inspired balconies.
The Oasis Villa II has two bedrooms and a separate living room.
Pools include the outdoor WET pool, the outdoor Rockpool and an indoor vitality pool.
Guests can play at the Padel & Pickle Jungle or work out at the FIT gym.
Spice Traders serves modern Chinese food with sweeping Arabian Sea views.
Guests can start the day with a sunrise at Vagator Beach or a walk up to Chapora Fort.

highlights.text: The hotel is set on Vagator Beach in North Goa, with the Arabian Sea on one side.
ROCKPOOL is a cliffside cocktail bar with sweeping Arabian Sea views and live music at sunset.
Installations by Goan artist Subodh Kerkar are placed at various spots around the hotel.
AWAY Spa offers cryotherapy and restorative therapies.
The hotel can arrange a private guided hike up Vagator's black rocks to the 500-year-old Chapora Fort.

considerations.text: After sunset, WOOBAR has live DJ sets and a lively atmosphere.
Pets are permitted in villas and chalets.
WhataHotel notes the party atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
